<script setup lang="ts">
import type { OTPFieldRootEmits, OTPFieldRootProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/otp-field'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { OTPField } from '@vase-ui/vue/otp-field'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ OTPFieldRootProps {
  length: OTPFieldRootProps['length']
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}
interface Emits extends /* @vue-ignore */ OTPFieldRootEmits {}

const props = defineProps<Props>()
defineEmits<Emits>()
</script>

<template>
  <OTPField.Root
    v-slot="slotProps"
    :length="length"
    data-slot="input-otp"
    :class="cn('gap-2 flex items-center has-disabled:opacity-50', props.class)"
  >
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </OTPField.Root>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { OTPField } from '@vase-ui/vue/otp-field'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const props = defineProps<{ class?: HTMLAttributes['class'] }>()

const active = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <OTPField.Input>
    <template #element="{ props: inputProps, elementRef }">
      <input
        v-bind="inputProps"
        :ref="elementRef"
        data-slot="input-otp-slot"
        :data-active="active"
        :class="cn('border-transparent border-b-input bg-transparent data-[active=true]:border-b-ring aria-invalid:border-b-destructive dark:aria-invalid:border-b-destructive/50 size-10 border text-sm transition-[color,border-color] outline-none first:rounded-none last:rounded-none relative text-center disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-[active=true]:z-10', props.class)"
        @focus="active = true"
        @blur="active = false"
      >
    </template>
  </OTPField.Input>
</template>

export { default as InputOTP } from './InputOTP.vue'
export { default as InputOTPGroup } from './InputOTPGroup.vue'
export { default as InputOTPSeparator } from './InputOTPSeparator.vue'
export { default as InputOTPSlot } from './InputOTPSlot.vue'
